steps.en: Officer searches for a notice to record the warrant outcome
steps.id: Officer mencari notice untuk mencatat outcome warrant
steps.why_en: The search box exists, but the data behind it cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Kotak pencarian ada, tetapi data di belakangnya tidak bisa dipastikan di sini.

steps.en: Officer picks the outcome: executed, cancelled, issued or DNATA
steps.id: Officer memilih outcome: executed, cancelled, issued atau DNATA
steps.why_en: No screen or choice for warrant outcomes exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau pilihan outcome warrant.

steps.en: OCMS saves the outcome and notice status
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan outcome dan status notice
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyimpan outcome warrant.

steps.en: OCMS sends the warrant update request to State Courts
steps.id: OCMS mengirim permintaan update warrant ke State Courts
steps.why_en: Nothing is sent to State Courts; the one court link only receives data.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang dikirim ke State Courts; satu-satunya link court hanya menerima data.
